blocks.text: Basic business planning involves setting clear goals for what a business wants to achieve. It includes identifying a product or service, understanding the target market, and deciding how to deliver value to customers. Entrepreneurs also plan resources such as time, money, and skills needed to run the business. A simple business plan helps organize ideas and provides direction for starting and growing a successful digital business.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Most failed startups do not have a clear plan.
